title: Key and Door
premise: Walk to the storage room for the key, return to the hall, and use the key on the vault door to open the way.

locations.name: Hall
locations.description: A stone hall. A sealed vault door stands to the north.

locations.name: Storage
locations.description: A dusty storeroom; something may be hidden on the shelves.

locations.name: Vault
locations.description: The vault inner chamber. Enter only after the door is open.

persons.name: Traveler
persons.background: A lone traveler who likes solving practical puzzles around town.
persons.goal: Explore the hall and figure out how the vault door works

items.name: DoorKey
items.description: Opens VaultDoor. Use it on the door in Hall.

items.name: VaultDoor
items.description: Heavy vault door. Accepts DoorKey via world-configured graph ops.

quests.name: OpenTheVault
quests.description: Get the key and open the vault door.
quests.objective: Collect DoorKey, then Use item on VaultDoor.

facts.name: KeyInStorage
facts.text: The DoorKey rests on a shelf in Storage.
